source: the proxy's traced launch on nexus of 2026-11-11, reduced to the shape north#1106 records: a status look, then strace around north fleet launch over ssh to find the missing file behind the DeepSeek launch failures of north#1020; the transcript stays on whiterabbit

calls.command: north fleet tree 2>&1 | rg -v exited | head -40
ssh nexus 'cd ~/code/north/main && strace -f -e trace=file -o /tmp/launch.strace north fleet launch --provider opencode --task north#1042 brief; rg ENOENT /tmp/launch.strace | tail -20'
